data.situation:
Half an hour later, Maya returned to the bench beside the ramp. A visitor was sitting there with his friend. He had slipped on the path outside the rope, but had managed to grip the handrail before falling. A trained first-aid worker had already attended to him. In the incident note, she described his injuries as minor. Maya had seen her wind a bandage around his arm; the visitor was now holding his sleeve clear of it. Jo brought the man's bag from the fence and put it beside the bench. His friend read the time on the note, then asked whom to contact with a later question. The worker wrote a contact name at the bottom before handing it over. INCIDENT NOTE — 22 MAY, 10:30
Location: path beside the ramp, outside the rope.
Visitor's account: ‘I slipped and gripped the handrail.’
Worker's record: minor injuries; a bandage was wound around the visitor's arm.
A copy of this note was given to the visitor. Jo brought his bag from the fence; his friend stayed with him.

readingBlocks.zh: 半小时后，玛雅回到坡道旁的长椅。一位访客和朋友坐在那里。他在围绳外的小路上滑了一下，但在跌倒前设法紧握住了扶手。一位受过培训的急救人员已经照看过他。她在情况记录里把他的伤情描述为轻伤。玛雅看见她把绷带绕在他的胳膊上；此时访客正把袖子提起，不让它碰到绷带。乔从围栏边拿来他的包，放在长椅旁。他的朋友看了记录上的时间，接着问之后有问题该联系谁。工作人员在底部写上联系人姓名，才把记录交给他们。

readingBlocks.zh:
情况记录——5月22日10:30
地点：坡道旁、围绳外的小路。
访客陈述：“我滑了一下，紧握住了扶手。”
工作人员记录：轻伤；已在访客胳膊上绕好绷带。
一份记录副本已交给访客。乔从围栏边取回了他的包；朋友陪着他。

glossary.note: grip 是及物动词，表示紧紧握住；过去式为 gripped。grip the handrail 表示紧握扶手。
glossary.example: He managed to grip the handrail before falling.
glossary.exampleZh: 他在跌倒前设法紧握住扶手。

glossary.note: 形容词 minor 修饰 injuries；本故事伤情来自受训人员已填写的记录。
glossary.example: The worker described his injuries as minor.
glossary.exampleZh: 工作人员把他的伤情描述为轻伤。

glossary.note: wind /waɪnd/ 是缠绕；过去式与过去分词为 wound /waʊnd/。wind a bandage around an arm 表示把绷带缠在胳膊上。
glossary.example: Maya had seen her wind a bandage around his arm.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅看见她把绷带绕在他的胳膊上。
